integrity: Finite exact arithmetic witness, all 121 Fourier evaluations reproducible without nonstandard libraries; independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Only the explicit eleven-element field and seven-point support are covered; no global maximality is proved.
The ten-zero upper estimate appears in version one of the source, not in its subsequent narrowed version, and is not part of the verified new claim.
title: An exact nine-zero seven-point Fourier witness on the parabola over the eleven-element field
